dct_description_sm: Metshallitus has the national responsibility of promoting conservation and organising monitoring of certain threatened species, or species which are mentioned in the Habitats Directive. In Sub-Arctic three vascular plant species are monitored regularly: Hairy stonecrop (Sedum villosum), Wall hawk's-beard (Crepis tectorum ssp. Nigrescens), Fragrant shield fern (Dryopteris fragrans).
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Conservation
dct_title_s: Monitoring of threatened and/or European Union habitat directive's vascular plants in Subarctic Finland
